item.title: 32 mil reproducciones · 145 reacciones | Welcome to Countdown to GameDay presented by @VegasExperiences ! The crew heads to Salt Lake City as No. 10 Utah hosts No. 14 Houston in a huge Big 12 showdown with College Football Playoff implications. Jess Sims, Harry Lyles Jr., and Harry Douglas break down the biggest matchup of the day, including the battle between Houston quarterback Conner Weigman and Utah’s tough defense, as well as the success of Devon Dampier and the undefeated Utes. Jen Lada joins from Utah to discuss the atmosphere and what each team needs to do to win, while Isaac Rochell and Zack Moss stop by to share their thoughts on the season and tonight’s game. The crew also previews key games around the country, including Ole Miss vs. Texas, Alabama vs. Texas A&M, LSU vs. Auburn, Indiana vs. Michigan, and USC vs. Wisconsin, while highlighting players, matchups, and teams to watch as Week 8 gets underway. 🏈 | ESPN
